collection.title: Peugeot 3008 2009 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Peugeot 3008 SUV 2009 to 2017 model which requires a 32" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 27" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this 3008, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
